value.rationale: The smallest overlapping binary-cylinder stochastic-hole model has an exact fair-switching universality for every hole pair despite inhomogeneous instantaneous hazard, and an arbitrarily small bias breaks this into precisely four strict escape-rate classes. This complete finite and asymptotic phase classification isolates a natural stochastic dynamical mechanism, not a routine generic perturbation bound.
